description: Compose a caption from a content hint and save it as a draft in sprkly, shaped to the tightest caption limit among the target platforms. Returns a draft id; the draft appears under /drafts for the user to review.

content_hint.description: What the post should be about: a topic, phrase, or key message.

platforms.description: Intended platforms, used to pick the caption length ceiling.

profile_ids.description: Optional accounts to pre-select on the draft. From sprkly_list_profiles.

name: sprkly_draft_post
title: Draft a post
